'''Kanga''' is a [[Nilo-Saharan languages|Nilo-Saharan language]] of the [[Kadu languages|Kadu]] branch spoken in [[South Kordofan]], [[Sudan]].

The Kufa-Lima dialect is spoken in Bilenya, Dologi, Lenyaguyox, Lima, Kilag, Kufa, Mashaish, and Toole villages, with Toole as the central village.<ref name=e27/>

A preliminary grammar of the Kufa-Lima variety (termed "Kufo") has been published recently.<ref>{{Cite thesis|type=Honours thesis|first=Keira|last=Mullan|date=2022|title=Nominal number and gender in Kufo: A description of its derivational and inflectional systems|publisher=Australian National University|doi=10.25911/G63X-DT44}}</ref>

A phonological description of the Kufa-Lima variety (termed "Kufo") has been developed,<ref>{{Cite thesis|type=Honours thesis|first=Shubo|last=Li|date=2022|title=A phonological sketch of the Kufo language|publisher=Australian National University|doi=10.25911/QQPD-PP24}}</ref> and the vowel inventory has been investigated with acoustic phonetic evidence.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Li |first1=Shubo |title=The vowel inventory of the Kufo language |journal=Proceedings of the Eighteenth Australasian International Conference on Speech Science and Technology |date=2022 |pages=71–75 |publisher=Australasian Speech Science and Technology Association |url=https://sst2022.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/li-2022-the-vowel-inventory-of-the-kufo-language.pdf}}</ref>
